url.description: Public HTTPS document URL; credentials, nonstandard ports and local/private destinations are rejected.

offset.description: Zero-based segment index. Values greater than zero require expected_sha256; the native runtime enforces this before reading.

refresh.description: Fetch the source again instead of reusing the session cache.

expected_sha256.description: Require these exact source bytes; required for offset greater than zero and recommended for an explicit refresh.

expected_doi.description: Expected article DOI; a conflicting document DOI is rejected; absence remains unverified.
